subject: Thanks for APAC office hours — request for 30m product walkthrough
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finarch.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 20:12:00 +08:00
Subject: Follow-up from APAC office hours — interested in a short walkthrough

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the office hours session this morning — the run-through of routing and cost controls was really helpful. I’m Tom (Head of Data Platform at FinArch Analytics). We’re evaluating ways to reduce inference cost for batch embedding jobs and to run low-latency endpoints for internal agents.

Would love a 30-minute product walkthrough / discovery with someone from your AE team to see how Redwood might fit in (particularly around Dedicated pools and Smart routing). We prefer mornings SGT next week (Apr 27–29). I’m also happy to self-book if you share a Calendly.

Company: FinArch Analytics
Use case: embeddings for search + sub-100ms intent classification for live UI
Approx. monthly tokens: ~1.2B candidate tokens
Security concerns: SOC 2, data residency options — need a short checklist if possible.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Nguyen
Head of Data Platform | FinArch Analytics
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finarch.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 21:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from APAC office hours — interested in a short walkthrough

Hi Tom — great to meet you at the session, and thanks for the context. I looped in Ben Carter (our AE who covers Finance verticals) so he can run the walkthrough and scope next steps.

Quick options:
- Option A: Tue Apr 27, 10:00–10:30 SGT
- Option B: Wed Apr 28, 09:30–10:00 SGT
- Option C: Wed Apr 28, 15:00–15:30 SGT

If none of those work you can use our 30m booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min — Ben will join any booked slot.

Attached: office_hours_recap.pdf (one-pager from today’s session; includes a short SOC 2 / private deployment checklist).

Ben — brief: FinArch is evaluating embeddings and low-latency endpoints, ~1.2B token range, asking about SOC 2 and residency. If you want to propose a different set of times, please do.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
Attachments: office_hours_recap.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finarch.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 02:30:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from APAC office hours — interested in a short walkthrough

Hi Tom — thanks for reaching out and thanks Naomi for the intro. I’d be happy to do a 30-minute walkthrough focused on:
- Performance for sub-100ms classification (deployment patterns)
- Cost levers: batching, prefix caching, quantization recommendations
- Deployment options: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (residency notes)

Proposed: Tue Apr 27, 10:00 SGT — I’ll send an invite when we confirm. I included timezone conversions below for clarity:
- Tue Apr 27, 10:00 SGT = Tue Apr 27, 03:00 UTC
- If that’s early for you, alternative Wed Apr 28, 09:30 SGT works too.

Quick ask before the call: could you share a rough QPS / average sequence length and whether embeddings are batched offline or in-app? That helps me pick model/quantization suggestions to show.

I’ve also attached a calendar stub (proposal-dates.ics) — feel free to accept the slot or use Naomi’s Calendly link.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0182
Attachments: proposal-dates.ics (calendar invite stub)

Ben / Naomi — thanks both, 10:00 SGT on Tue Apr 27 works for me. I accepted the calendar stub.

Answers to quick asks:
- QPS (peak): ~120 requests/s for classification workloads
- Average sequence length: ~220 tokens for classification; embeddings vary (avg 1k tokens for batch jobs)
- Embeddings: currently batch offline nightly, exploring nearline generation during business hours

I attached a short intake spreadsheet (inf-request.xlsx) with contact info and compliance contacts — happy to add anything else you need. Please share the Zoom link for the meeting when you create the calendar event.
